title: GANs-for-Balancing-Datasets
summary: A research project tackling the IEEE Big Data 2022 'GAN-Based Training for Binary Classifier' challenge, using GAN models to balance an imbalanced binary-classification dataset of malignant/benign samples. It fits SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic minority-class data and evaluates the result with SDV's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic functions.
